issue.title: Obsidian requirement guards, toggle, drop, and typing assist
issue.description: Complete bob-cli-on.10 (the obsidian-gestures phase of plan:202611/task_requirements.md). The cycler, nav, and Block ID Prompt recognize requirement lines through byte-identical JS twins that pass bob-cli's RQ/RL/RW vectors. Every task gesture refuses or redirects on a req line with the contract copy. Ctrl+] toggles note and req with zone placement and the first-req scoop, Alt+[ drops with a reason and Alt+] restores, Ctrl+Shift+P opens the owner's Task Card, the offer-close scope note never counts reqs, and typing `- [` then space expands to `- [ ] ` with overtype absorption, atomic Backspace, Vim insert support, and a clean Undo. Each write is one undo step.

payload.entry: PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: bob-cli ^prj NOTES filing is broken (twin mirrors it, as the plan requires) — for a ^prj project task, file_into_notes → ensure_notes_drawer → capture_drawers::ensure_drawer takes the is_prj_parent path: it appends "## NOTES" at EOF and files notes at first_child_indentation/dominant unit (a tab under an H2 renders as an indented code block); because drawers() only lists bullet drawers, an existing "## NOTES" section is never found, so a second empty "## NOTES" heading is appended while the notes land in the first. bob task tidy refuses these plans via content_preserved ("it would add the line \"## NOTES\""), but the RW writers (toggle note→req first-req scoop, insert_reqs) have no such guard. No RL/RW vector covers ^prj. Decide the intended ^prj behaviour in bob-cli (contract §3), add vectors, and re-copy.

PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: bob plugins sync cannot deploy task-status-cycler without -F — the vault holds cycler 1.52.0 stamped clean from bob-cli_13 at 726f9a5, which was rebased and landed as 6e0d764 (manifest/main.js/styles.css all byte-identical, reachable from HEAD). deploy.rs only consults find_inclusion_proof for dirty stamps; the clean-stamp branch requires the stamped SHA to be an ancestor, so the documented "Landed" recipe (stash, ff, clean sync) still refuses. The deployment doc says a clean checkout reaching a byte-identical commit syncs without --force. Fix bob-cli to apply the inclusion proof to clean stamps too. This phase did not force (AGENTS.md); cycler 1.53.0 (inert twins) is not deployed, and req-write-twin, which must sync the cycler, will hit the same refusal.

req-read-twin done in bob-plugins (uncommitted at close; committed by this turn's final declaration). New pure, plugin-agnostic cycler fragments: 194-task-reqs-lines-twin.js (line spans, list items, fences, frontmatter, managed-line/log/drawer predicates, note_tasks scan with clean_description; Rust whitespace and UTF-8 indent comparisons), 195-task-reqs-twin.js (RQ: taskReqForest/ForOwner/InfoAtLine/OwnerOfLine/IsReqLine/PathText/RowKey(ownerKey,row,digest8)/Run; rows keep ledger-tools field names, Index fields are 0-based), 196-task-block-layout-twin.js (RL: classify, zones, taskBlockRead/InsertionSlot/DrawerHeaderOffset/Drawers/DrawerInsertion/EnsureNotesDrawer incl. the ^prj H2 path/NoteHome/DesiredOrder/LayoutViolations/FindTask), 197-task-block-tidy-twin.js (edit helpers PhysicalLines/WithEnding/Bare/RestoreFinalNewline/RebaseIndent/InsertLines/PullRanges/Rebased, ScoopLooseNotes, FileIntoNotes, PlanTidy), and 211-task-reqs-exports.js; slot 198 is free for the RW writers and 193 for the guard. Options are {globalFilter, statusTypes}; offsets are UTF-16. Fixtures README/vectors/layout copied byte for byte into plugins/task-status-cycler/scripts/fixtures/task_reqs/. scripts/test-task-status-cycler-task-reqs-vectors.cjs (in test:unit): all 21 RQ cases (every node field, probes, distinct row keys via node crypto, per-owner entry point), all 52 RL slots/violations/tidy (with no-violations-after and idempotence)/note_homes, fixture byte-equality against bob-cli, plus mirrors of bob-cli unit tests: 84/84 pass. Differential fuzz against a fresh bob-cli debug build (bob task tidy -f json dry run, scratch vaults): 4,200 random notes incl. CRLF, no final newline, frontmatter, fences, NBSP, ^prj, 0 mismatches. cycler manifest 1.53.0, docs:gen version cells. Gates: npm run build and build:check clean; docs inventory current; npm test 8384/8390 pass. The 2 failures reproduce identically on clean base: the stale cycler offer_close SV fixture (re-copied by req-write-twin step 3) and the known load flake test-ledger-tools-frees-marks.cjs:481 (passes 3/3 alone). npm run docs:check fails identically on base (word budgets: plugin-apis.md tracked by bob-cli-ob; reference bob-ledger-tools.md and bob-navigation-hotkeys.md). Not synced: see the sync follow-up note.

PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: offer-close project scope still diverges from bob-cli on #ref rows — the cycler project path (089h successorOfferCloseOpenScopeCount) counts top-level `- [ ] #ref …` reference rows via successorKeepMovingReferenceTasks, while bob-cli open_scope_count counts only parse_tasks (#task) rows. This phase made both paths exclude every req line (nested #ref reqs included), but a top-level #ref row still adds to "its N open tasks stay open" in Obsidian and not in bob-cli. Decide the intended rule in bob-cli, add an SV vector, and align the cycler.

New pure cycler fragment 198-task-reqs-writers-twin.js mirrors bob-cli writers.rs: taskReqDrop(contents,{lineIndex,preimage},date,reason,options) / taskReqRestore / taskReqToggle / taskReqInsert return {ok:true,updated,…RW fields} or {ok:false,code,message} with bob-cli's exact codes and copy (req_stale preimage check first; toggle adds firstReq). writes.json copied byte for byte; test-task-status-cycler-task-reqs-vectors.cjs now runs every RQ/RL/RW case through shared drivers in scripts/task-reqs-vectors.cjs plus RW refusal-copy, firstReq, reason/log, final-newline/mixed-EOL, and custom-filter tests (144/144). Differential fuzz vs a temporary (reverted, never committed) bob-cli ignored test over drop_req/restore_req/toggle_note_req/insert_reqs: 41,000 random cases across 11 seeds (CRLF, mixed endings, no final newline, frontmatter, fences, quotes, ^prj, depth>16 chains, every mark, cancel logs, drawers incl. existing NOTES), 0 mismatches, every refusal code and every success path (created/prepended logs, depth-1 moves, scoop with NOTES birth, req->note into new and existing NOTES) hit. Copies: nav 694-698 (all five twins) + 728-task-reqs-exports.js, Block ID Prompt 165-166 (RQ) + 171-task-reqs-exports.js; fixtures copied (nav all four, BIP README+vectors). New scripts/test-task-reqs-twin-copies.cjs (in test:unit): byte-identical fragments (drift detection verified by a deliberate edit), manifest order before exports, bundles carry fragments verbatim, all fixture copies identical incl. ledger-tools vectors.json and bob-cli canonical, matching exported helper sets, and every RQ vector through nav and BIP bundles plus every RL/RW vector through nav (7/7). Offer-close: offer_close vectors.json already matched bob-cli (refreshed by 909b30f); plugin README now names SV25; successorOfferCloseOpenScopeCount subtask path counts only open whole-token #task lines within child_block_end_line (spaces/tabs indent), project path excludes every req line via taskReqForest; SV25 added to the canonical-copy test plus a req/#ref/paragraph scope test — both fail on the old code, pass now. Manifests: cycler 1.54.0, nav 2.102.0, BIP 1.41.0; docs:gen. Gates: npm run build + build:check clean, docs inventory current; npm test 8490/8495 pass, sole failure the known load flake test-ledger-tools-frees-marks.cjs:481 (passes 3/3 alone; also noted on bob-cli-on.10.1.1 and bob-cli-oj.5.1.x). npm run docs:check: every plugin-docs stage passes; it fails only in bob-cli master's own tools/docs/tests/test_contracts.py (registry 55 vs pinned 54, README digest), independent of bob-plugins and already recorded on bob-cli-on.
